title: Semantic Segmentation datasets of Indian roads
description:
### Context
This dataset is created for delivery robots with knee heightened delivery robots. Sidewalk delivery robots can also use this dataset as it consists of side road data as well.

### Content
This dataset consists of a semantic segmentation dataset of Indian roads for roads, potholes, footpaths, shallow paths, and backgrounds. This dataset is tested using **MobileNetv3** and **ESPNetv2**.
